description: Find first-hand community sources for destination planning, citywalk and family trips / 攻略、游记、亲子旅行. Start with a short destination such as 上海 or 大理; space-separated keywords must all match. If empty, follow searchHints.suggestedQueries or retry the destination alone rather than repeatedly adding activity or duration words. Returns live-checked public posts with URLs, update times and text availability. Search excerpts are not full reads: call get_goora_post for each cited source. Not current inventory, bookings or payments.
name: search_goora_posts
title: 搜索 Goora 公开旅行帖子
